prompt:
You write realistic phone-call wording for a clinic scheduling test set.
For each scenario below, write what the caller would actually say for each listed field, the way a
note-taking assistant would record the caller's own words for that field (a short phrase, not a full
sentence). Vary the style across scenarios: casual, terse, older caller, non-native speaker, rambling.
Use only the facts in the scenario; do not add any other doctor, clinic or service. When the scenario
says the caller does not know the medical name, describe the need the way a layperson would, without
naming a medical specialty or a type of appointment. Do not use tools or open files; answer directly.

Return ONLY a JSON array, one object per scenario: {"id": ..., "<field>": "...", ...} with exactly the
fields listed for that scenario.

Scenarios:
- id h5-10: Existing patient: a parent whose 6-year-old son has had a stomach ache and has thrown up twice since this morning, and they want a doctor to look at him. They say how old he is. They do not know the medical name for it. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h5-20: Existing patient aged 70 who wants to book their 'AWV'. They say only 'AWV', do not spell it out and do not mention their insurance. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h5-m02: Existing patient who wants a flu shot with a specific doctor. Asked which Dr. Garcia they mean, Dr. Maria Garcia or Dr. Carlos Garcia, they answer: Carlos; they give only his first name. Fields: provider_phrase = how the caller names the doctor: Dr. Garcia, and that it is the family medicine doctor, said as a specialty, not 'my family doctor' (no first name); followup_provider_phrase = their answer when asked which Dr. Garcia they mean, Dr. Maria Garcia or Dr. Carlos Garcia: Carlos; they give only his first name

parsed.service_phrase: my son needs to be seen, he's 6, he's had a stomach ache and thrown up twice since this morning

parsed.provider_phrase: Dr. Garcia, the family medicine doctor
